p.s: According to me the best way to travel is not in a group led by a tour guide.

first of all, the best way to enjoy to travel is to go with an other person, its n't good to go with a group, because it 's difficult to share your feeling and make a plan quickly and efficiently with many people together.

For example if you need to shop you have to be worried about of the feeling of your group, but it 's more easy when you travel with a friend or a menber of your family to change the schedule of your journey.
Secondly, all of your mouvements during the travel are restricted because you are in a group.

For instance, if you have plan to enjoy to eat in different restaurant, if you will meet many new people, it 's not possible to do this in a group because during the travel you are always with your group, so you do n't have the time to meet someone and the travel can be borried.
Finally, if you travel with a guide you are not able to quit the group and to do what you want to do.
You have to follow the instruction of the tour guide it 's like a travel information that 's not good.

For example if you go to some country in Africa like Ivory Coast, all the tourist like to go to yamoussokro to see the biggest catholic church in the world, the tourists do n't take the time to visit the capital which containts some interesting stuff too.
In conclusion the best way to travel is with a partner like a friend or a menber of your family it 's more fun.
On the other hand, that depend of what are you planning to do and what 's your purpose.
For instance if you want to travel for a history class or whatever.
I agree that the best way to travel is in a group led by a tour guide.
In fact you can take all the information who want about the topics of your class.
